title: Flydubai's Vetting Scandal, Frontier's Fake Boarding Pass Guy, and the UK's Half-Baked Fee Ban
summary: The flydubai cockpit attacker was reportedly banned from flying at a previous airline over extremism concerns — so how did he end up in a 737 cockpit anyway? Plus, a Frontier flight gets deplaned over a guy with a fake boarding pass, and the UK promises to ban "rip-off" airline fees while quietly keeping some of the highest aviation taxes on Earth.
